newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool business slack ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool business slack ahead of holiday.

text.p: Prices showed littl change on the Bradford wool market on Thursday with business tending to slacken ahead of next week's UK Public holiday which will see many Bradford wool testile firms take a week long break.
Where interest was evident it generally meant that sellers had to come down, sometimes accepting prices that failed to reflect repalcement costs.
Combing activity was high and the worsted sector generally was busy.
Brokers said there were no Australian wool sales to give a lead to prices but some encouragement was drawn from prices merino wool fetched in South Africa, particularly mille micro categories.
New Zealand crossbred sales levels confirmed this sectors firmer tendency recently, brokers said.
